# Link audit

- Check links in changed resource sections.
- Prefer canonical project publisher or documentation URLs.
- Detect duplicate destinations under alternate labels.
- Flag dead moved or clearly obsolete references.
- Preserve historical resources only when intentionally labeled.
- Recheck Markdown formatting after edits.
